policy: A term that frames one political side, group, or contested position must be flagged with the same type as its mirror: the equivalent framing from the other side. If no sensible mirror exists, flag neither and list the term under `deferred`. Device-based terms (passive voice, agency hiding, clickbait, hype) apply to anyone who uses them and are not mirrored. tests/run.js enforces both lists.
